      🚀 We’re hiring a Senior Data Analyst @ Alma Labs!

      Alma is an AI fluency and human development platform-built for an AI-native future. We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead our measurement framework, product insights, and data interface, reporting directly to the Head of Data.


      📌 The Role

      •⁠ ⁠Shape company-wide KPIs alongside Product & Engineering.

      •⁠ ⁠Own our internal AI querying tool and elevate data quality.

      •⁠ ⁠Deliver deep product, CS, and leadership insights + client-facing dashboards.


      🎯 What You Bring

      •⁠ ⁠6+ years in analytics with strong SQL & OLAP experience (ClickHouse / Snowflake).

      •⁠ ⁠Modern cloud data skills, strong data modeling, and BI fluency.

      •⁠ ⁠AI-first mindset, you use LLM tools daily to speed up your workflow.

      •⁠ ⁠Strategic thinking and full ownership.


      📍 Location: Central Tel Aviv

      ✉️ Apply: Send your CV to ella.v@almalabs.ai
